title: I released a cozy little Metal Detector Simulator where you can clean up the beach while you find treasure
author: PremiumAISlop
selftext:
Hey everyone! I just released my new game, **Metal Detector Simulator**, on Steam!

🔗 [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5372570/Metal\_Detector\_Simulator/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5372570/Metal_Detector_Simulator/)

The idea behind this game was pretty simple: I wanted to make something stress-free that I could just sit down and enjoy playing. No pressure, no complicated objectives to worry about - just head out with a metal detector, search around, and see what you find. Honestly, it's the kind of game I wanted to play myself, and I hope other people find it relaxing too.

I'm also developing under the name **Premium AI Slop**, because I figured if we're going to make games with AI, we might as well be up front with it and have a little fun with the name :)

I also have a few Steam keys available if anyone wants to try it out. Just leave a comment or send me a DM, and I'll get some out to people who are interested.

Thanks for checking it out!
